verdict.rationale: Rippling docs confirm automatic payroll tax calculation and filing (rippling-docs-40, rippling-docs-44) and that employees can view 'tax forms' anytime (rippling-docs-15), implying year-end forms are generated and accessible, but no evidence explicitly names W-2/1099 generation or describes automatic distribution to workers at year-end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of W-2/1099 form generation, timing/automation of year-end issuance, and any independent confirmation that these forms are actually produced and delivered without manual intervention.
